notes.R03a: PASS (strict) 500/500 front-facing after the dock-trunk fix in 20_exterior.py: the flat dorsal skin under EXT_DOCK_Collar is opened along its seams (X -0.9..0, Y 1.05..2.05) with a rim (EXT_HULL_DockOpeningRim); rays up the open ceiling hatch now end on the closed EXT_DOCK_Hatch (front faces). Before the fix: 494/500 (6 hits on the skin underside).
notes.B01: Unpressurised sensor bay, nose. All back-face hits are EXT_HULL_Fuselage (hull skin); rays come from every side (+/-X sides, +Y nose cone, -Z belly) with open space behind = single-layer outer skin, not a hole. The bay has no aft lining, so some rays travel aft inside the hull and end on the skin interior around the cockpit shell (hit Y down to 3.6) - still inside the skin.
notes.B02: Nose gear well: closed in the model (500/500 hits from centre and free point). Centre lies inside the strut; free-point back faces are the belly skin (-Z) around the well = hull-skin interior.
notes.B03: Free point 99.8 % front-facing (1 back-face hit on the belly skin).
notes.B04_L: Main gear well L: closed (500/500). Back faces = EXT_HULL_Sponson_L interior, mostly -Z (sponson belly).
notes.B04_R: Main gear well R: closed (500/500). Back faces = EXT_HULL_Sponson_R interior, mostly -Z.
notes.B05: Tank bay: back faces all EXT_HULL_Fuselage interior, +/-X sides and -Z belly, open space behind.
notes.B06: Reactor bay: centre inside INT_B06_ReactorVessel; from the free point all back faces are the fuselage skin interior (+/-X, -Z, -Y aft bulkhead skin).
notes.B07: Engine bay: back faces all EXT_HULL_Fuselage interior, mostly +Z (dorsal skin over the engine bay) and -Z belly; open space behind.
notes.exterior: PASS: 2,084 of 4,000 inbound rays hit the ship, 100 % front-facing (unchanged by the dock fix; the opening lies entirely under the collar skirt).

dock_fix_impact.method: primary-ray first-hit map (object + hit point at 1 mm) from each preview camera at 1/4 render resolution, old blend (pre-fix, sha e255f924...) vs new blend; identical map = no visible change of the frame
dock_fix_impact.conclusion: no preview shows the dock opening (it lies entirely under the 0.72 m collar skirt); differences in 24/25 are 3 sub-millimetre float ties on coincident surfaces at Y 0.75-1.87 dorsal skin/bolt row, not the opening. No preview re-rendered.
